2.title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted

3.title: Missouri Asks Supreme Court to Allow Voting Map Benefiting Republicans
3.summary: Missouri’s Supreme Court said a map redrawn to help Republicans could not be used in November and said voters should decide on the new boundaries.

4.title: US envoys arrive in Moscow ahead of Ukraine talks
4.summary: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are due to hold talks with Russia before travelling to Ukraine on Sunday.

5.title: U.S. Strikes Three Iranian ‘Shadow Network’ Oil Tankers, Military Says
5.summary: The U.S. military said it retaliated after Iran launched missiles at two warships. The strikes came days after the two sides exchanged some of their most intense fire in weeks.
